study type: retrospective analysis of a prospective cohort study
exposure: pulsatility index (PI) of anterior cerebral artery (ACA)
pulsatility index (PI) of middle cerebral artery (MCA)
pulsatility index (PI) of posterior cerebral artery (PCA)
outcome: caesarean section for nonreassuring fetal status
cohort: 224 singleton pregnancies from 40 0/7 to 41 6/7 weeks gestation
finding: Redistribution of cerebral blood flow at term is significantly associated with small for gestational age, induction of labor for oligohydramnios, and caesarean section for nonreassuring fetal status during labor.
